name: Mitomycin + fluorouracil with concurrent radiation (bladder trimodality)
cyclesNote: Single concurrent chemoradiation course (BC2001-type radiosensitization): mitomycin once at the start of radiation plus fluorouracil infusion during weeks 1 and 4 of the radiation course. Encoded as one approximately 6-week course (cycles = 1).

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Mitomycin plus fluorouracil is a cisplatin-free radiosensitizing option during bladder-preserving trimodality therapy, useful when cisplatin is unsuitable. DPYD testing is advised before fluoropyrimidine exposure.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Give on chemotherapy days concurrent with radiation.

supportiveCare: Single definitive concurrent chemoradiation course (NOT a repeating cycle); fluorouracil infusion is timed to radiation weeks 1 and 4.
Fluoropyrimidine DPYD testing per FDA boxed warning before starting.
Monitor for mitomycin myelosuppression and radiation cystitis/proctitis; restaging cystoscopy + biopsy after the course.
monitoring: CBC before each administration and during nadir (mitomycin/5-FU)
renal function and signs of hemolytic-uremic syndrome / thrombotic microangiopathy (mitomycin)
radiation cystitis / proctitis during the course

doseModificationRules.text: Adjust the second fluorouracil infusion for cytopenias; obtain clinical review. Physician decides.
Reduce dose or avoid fluorouracil in DPYD-deficient patients per FDA boxed warning; clinical review required.

drugs.name: mitomycin
drugs.notes: mitomycin 12 mg/m2 IV bolus once on day 1 (start of radiation), each dose capped at about 20 mg. ISMP: 'mitomycin' is confused with mitoXANTRONE. Own wording; standard reference dose.

provenance.locator: Principles of bladder preservation - mitomycin + 5-FU radiosensitization (BC2001-type)

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: Fluorouracil 500 mg/m2/day by continuous IV infusion during radiation weeks 1 and 4 (representative days shown). DPYD: FDA boxed warning advises testing before a fluoropyrimidine; dose-reduce or avoid in DPYD-deficient patients. Own wording; standard reference dose.

provenance.locator: Principles of bladder preservation - mitomycin + 5-FU radiosensitization (BC2001-type)
